title: Leica iCON iCB50 Manual Construction Total Station
summary:
The iCB50 is the entry point into the iCON family: a manual construction total station with one-key operation and the iCON build field software inside. It is the straightforward upgrade from tape and chalk, aimed at crews that need a total station to set out and check work rather than to run a long survey.

Two-second accuracy, 3,500 m to a prism, and a colour touch display with iCON build keep the job moving: set out points from a drawing, check as-built against design, and log what you find without a separate data collector.

For layout of walls, columns, and foundations, formwork checks, interior fit-out, and everyday site measurement, it covers the work without the complexity of a robotic setup.
specs: Angular accuracy 2 and 5 seconds (horizontal and vertical), 1-second display resolution
Prism range 1.5-3,500 m; single prism 1 mm + 1.5 ppm, typically 2.4 s; continuous 3 mm + 1.5 ppm
Non-prism 0-500 m at 2 mm + 2 ppm, typically 3-6 s
30x telescope, 3-second resolving power, focus 1.55 m to infinity
5-inch WVGA colour touch display with 22 keys, running iCON build
Compensator setting 0.5 and 1.5 seconds, working range +/- 4 minutes
GEB361 battery up to 18 h; 4.5 kg; IP66, operating -20 to +50 degrees C
accessories: Prism pole with prism and holder
